newsitem.title: MEXICO: Desc unit in agreement with JSR.
newsitem.headline: Desc unit in agreement with JSR.

text.p: Industrias Negromex (INSA), a subsidiary of Mexican conglomerate Desc S.A de C.V., said it reached a basic agreement with Japan Synthetic Rubber (JSR) to open a new factory in Mexico, or the United States, the company said in a press statement on Wednesday.
"The new U.S.-based partnership will begin to market products made at INSA's plant using JSR technology to jointly build a factory to be located in Mexico or the United States," the statement said.
The statement did not specify how much the deal between the two companies could be worth.
Officials at INSA were not available for contact.
(( --Tomas de la Rosa, Mexico City newsroom +525 728-7912))
